adversarialFinding.what: Poisoning the last earned cell of a rail demotes it to declared-ahead and the gate PASSES.
adversarialFinding.mechanism1: deriveLiveRailKeys sees zero earned cells for that rail, so evaluatePublishGate stops scoring it.
adversarialFinding.mechanism2Rejected: poisonCell failed to write unaccounted — rejected because a two-parcel poison of the same rail still refuses.
adversarialFinding.disposition: Documented as the decision's known limit. Violation test uses two parcels so the rail stays live. Extra test locks the demotion behaviour so it cannot be mistaken for a gate bug.
